rows.note: Use this for the physical office room where clerical or professional work is done.

example.english: I'm working in the bureau right now.
example.traditional: 我而家喺辦公室做緊嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 baan6 gung1 sat1 zou6 gan2 je5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an organization’s bureau, service office, or branch office.

example.english: This bureau is open from nine to six.
example.traditional: 呢間辦事處朝九晚六都開門。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 baan6 si6 cyu3 ziu1 gau2 maan5 luk6 dou1 hoi1 mun4

rows.note: Use this for a government bureau or an institutional information bureau, especially when it is an official department.

example.english: Residents can go to the transport bureau to apply for a licence.
example.traditional: 市民可以去運輸局申請牌照。
example.jyutping: si5 man4 ho2 ji5 heoi3 wan6 syu1 guk6 san1 cing2 paai4 ziu3

rows.note: Use this for a writing desk with a surface and compartments for storing papers.

example.english: I keep my documents in the compartment above the bureau.
example.traditional: 我將啲文件收喺寫字枱上面嗰格。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 man4 gin6 sau1 hai2 se2 zi6 toi2 soeng6 min6 go2 gaak3
